say:1:1710352001:0.text: ... Princess Peggy?! How did you wind up in this godforsaken place?
say:1:1710352001:0.source_cn: 是……是佩吉公主？！殿下！您怎么也会在这个鬼地方？

say:2:1710352002:1.text: Please help us! Those armors outside... they've come to life!
say:2:1710352002:1.source_cn: 公主殿下！感谢艾雅！救救我们！外面那些盔甲……它们活了！

say:4:1710352003:1.text: Your Highness, I'm Ralph, chief editor of "The Savannah Morning Post". Please excuse our rudeness, but... this is an emergency.
say:4:1710352003:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，鄙人乃《赛凡纳晨报》的主编伦道夫。请恕我们失...

say:5:1710352004:1.text: Formalities don't matter now. By the way, how did you all get here with the entrance already gone?
say:5:1710352004:1.source_cn: 现在不是多礼的时候。你们……是怎么进来的？大门明明已经...

say:6:1710352005:1.text: I-I have no idea. I was hosting a tea party in the garden. Just as I reached for my cup...
say:6:1710352005:1.source_cn: 这……我也不知道。我正在花园里举办茶会，刚端起一杯红茶……

say:7:1710352006:1.text: The garden and the guests suddenly vanished, and I ended up here all by myself! How terrifying!
say:7:1710352006:1.source_cn: 眨眼之间，花园没了，客人们也没了，而我孤身一人来到了这...

say:9:1710352007:1.text: Something similar happened to me! I was in my study, reviewing the festival's expenditure sheets...
say:9:1710352007:1.source_cn: 我也是！殿下！我当时正在府邸的书房内，审阅庆典开支报表……

say:10:1710352008:1.text: The second I picked up my quill, my vision went black. I thought my old ailment was acting up! By the time I opened my eyes again, I found myself sitting on this cold, hard floor!
say:10:1710352008:1.source_cn: 我刚拿起羽毛笔，只觉得眼前一黑，还以为自己老毛病犯了！...

say:11:1710352009:1.source_cn: 公主殿下，我刚才躲在这里观察了许久。

say:12:1710352010:1.text: These coffins, and the interior design... If I'm not mistaken, are we in the <style="highlight">Hall of Ancients</style>?
say:12:1710352010:1.source_cn: 这陈列的棺椁，还有内饰的风格……如果我没看错的话……这...

say:14:1710352011:1.source_cn: 没错，这里是圣古堂内部。

say:15:1710352012:1.text: Dura above, that urgent message was true! Your Highness, I just received word from one of my reporters...
say:15:1710352012:1.source_cn: 艾雅啊，原来那个急报是真的！公主殿下，就在刚才，我的记...

say:16:1710352013:1.text: He said the Hall of Ancients <style="highlight">vanished into thin air</style> right after you and the court mage stepped in!
say:16:1710352013:1.source_cn: 整个圣古堂，在众目睽睽之下，<style=highli...

say:19:1710352015:1.source_cn: 在我们踏入圣古堂之后？

say:20:1710352016:1.text: Exactly! I was just about to put this breaking news on the front page, but I ended up here myself!
say:20:1710352016:1.source_cn: 是的！我正准备要把这个惊天头条排上版面，结果自己也进来了！

say:21:1710352017:1.text: I see... So Princess Peggy and I didn't move at all... The entire Hall of Ancients shifted!
say:21:1710352017:1.source_cn: 原来并非我和公主被传送……而是整座圣古堂连同内部空间一...

say:22:1710352018:1.text: If Ralph's account is true, then the magic at work here is far more complex than I thought.
say:22:1710352018:1.source_cn: 殿下，如果伦道夫主编说的是真的，那这就不是简单的“封门”了。

say:23:1710352019:1.text: ... To move something as massive as this chapel would take an enormous amount of mana and a highly advanced magic circle...
say:23:1710352019:1.source_cn: ……要把圣古堂这种体量的存在从现实空间转移，这需要的巨...

say:24:1710352020:1.text: Looks like we've fallen into a well-laid trap.
say:24:1710352020:1.source_cn: 看来，这是一个精心设计的陷阱。

say:26:1710352021:1.text: Trap?! Are we going to die? I'm not ready for that!
say:26:1710352021:1.source_cn: 陷阱？！那我们会死吗？我不想死啊！

say:28:1710352022:1.text: For crying out loud, I didn't do anything wrong!
say:28:1710352022:1.source_cn: 不要吧，我什么都没做啊？！

say:29:1710352023:1.text: <style="highlight">Silence!</style> Are you trying to draw the magic armors here?!

say:30:1710352024:1.text: Peggy's commanding presence silences the nobles, leaving only the sound of their fearful breaths. Outside, the approaching footsteps linger for a moment before fading away.
say:30:1710352024:1.source_cn: 贵族们被佩吉的气势震慑，瞬间安静下来，只有恐惧的呼吸声...

say:31:1710352025:1.text: Listen, we need to keep our cool if we want to survive. Since we're in this together, I, Peggy Augusta, won't leave any of you behind.
say:31:1710352025:1.source_cn: 听着。现在慌乱解决不了任何问题，只会让我们送命。既然我...

say:32:1710352026:1.text: Cassadee's one of the empire's finest mages. She'll keep watch on the magic armors.
say:32:1710352026:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂也是全耀光最优秀的魔法师之一，她会负责侦查那些盔...

say:33:1710352027:1.text: And I know a path that could free us. But you must follow my lead and keep clear of the magic armors!
say:33:1710352027:1.source_cn: 我知道一条路，或许能带大家离开这里。前提是你们得听指挥...

say:34:1710352028:1.text: If you don't want to die here, bend down and stick close to me! Don't make a sound!
say:34:1710352028:1.source_cn: 不想死在这里的，就弯下腰，跟紧我！一点声音都别发出来！
